definitions.component: Weakly connected component of non-COPY ops under direct op edges and producer-tensor-consumer edges.
definitions.cross_component_copy_in: Tensor consumed by compute ops in at least two components and produced by exactly one COPY_IN op.
definitions.partial: Such a tensor is consumed by fewer than all compute components in its graph.
definitions.consumer_group: Exact set of compute-component indices consuming the same COPY_IN tensor. Indices are zero based after sorting components by minimum op ID.

scope: Graph structure only; no plan validity, capacity feasibility, Task behavior, E0/E1/E2 result, or Makespan claim.
